cases.situation: I just got into a PhD program in Edinburgh, starting in January, so I'm moving from Toronto. My best friend Zoe and I have lived 10 minutes apart for 8 years. I want to tell her before I post anything.
cases.reply: Wanted you to hear this from me before it's anywhere else: I got into the PhD in Edinburgh! It starts in January, so I'm moving over. I'm thrilled and also already missing you. Can I take you for dinner Friday and tell you everything?
cases.note: Closest people first, individually. The news, one line of feeling, what's next.

cases.situation: 我和老公阿杰决定离婚了，已经和平协商好。想在大学室友的四人群里说一声，免得她们以后问起尴尬，但不想被追问细节。
cases.reply: 跟你们说件事，统一说一次就不再重复啦：我和阿杰决定离婚了，已经好好谈过，是和平分开的。我还好，就是需要点时间适应。不想聊原因，但很想这阵子多见见你们，下个月谁有空一起吃个饭？
cases.note: 群里说一次，直接告诉大家怎么回应：不问细节，要陪伴。

cases.situation: I'm pregnant (due in April) and want to tell my close friend Hana, who's been doing IVF for two years. I don't want her to find out from the group chat.
cases.reply: I wanted to tell you this one directly and quietly, because I know it's not simple for you right now: I'm pregnant, due in April. You don't have to say anything, and you don't have to be anything but honest with me about how it lands. I love you, and I'll tell the group next week.
cases.note: For news that may hurt the reader, a separate gentle message first, with explicit permission not to respond.

cases.situation: I'm leaving my accounting job at Hartwell & Finch on Oct 30 to run my bakery full time; I've saved eight months of expenses and my Saturday market stall already covers its costs. My parents sacrificed a lot for my degree and they'll worry. We have our usual call Sunday but I want to text first so it's not an ambush.
cases.reply: Mom, Dad, I want to tell you something before our call on Sunday so you have time to take it in: I'm leaving Hartwell & Finch on October 30 to run the bakery full time. I've saved eight months of expenses and the Saturday market stall already covers its own costs. I know how much you gave for that degree, and I'll be using every bit of it on my own business. On Sunday I'd love your questions, and I'd love it if we could start from being happy for me.
cases.note: News likely to worry the reader: lead with the fact, give the two numbers that answer the first fear, and say how you hope they'll respond.

cases.situation: 我是产品经理，昨天和组里大概三分之一的人一起被裁了。想在五个好朋友的微信群里说一声，最想要的是大家帮我留意合适的产品岗位，不需要安慰。
cases.reply: 跟大家说个事：我昨天被裁了，组里大概三分之一的人一起。我还行，就是有点懵。下周开始找新工作，你们身边如果有产品经理的岗位，帮我留意一下、推给我就是最大的帮忙。别的不用操心，也不用安慰我，就是想让你们知道。
cases.note: 坏消息先想清楚要什么：这里要的是实际帮忙，就直接说一件具体的事，并说明不需要安慰。

cases.situation: I've been diagnosed with breast cancer, caught early. Surgery is Oct 14 and I'll be off about six weeks, with Rohan covering my projects. My manager knows; I want to email my team of 5 myself but I don't want lots of questions.
cases.reply: Hi all, I wanted you to hear this from me: I've been diagnosed with breast cancer. It was caught early. I'm having surgery on Wednesday, Oct 14, and will be off for about six weeks; Rohan is covering my projects and has everything he needs. I'd rather not go into details, but kind messages are very welcome and you don't need to find the perfect words. I'll send a short note when I'm back.
cases.note: Hard news at work: the fact, the practical plan, and a clear signal for how to respond.

cases.situation: Last week I told my close friends' group chat that I'd been laid off. Most were lovely, but Jake replied 'lol enjoy the paid vacation, wish that was me'. It stung because I'm genuinely worried about money. He's a good friend, just clumsy. Should I say something?
cases.reply: Hey Jake, that one landed a bit hard. I know you didn't mean it that way, I'm just still raw on this and money's a real worry right now. Fancy a pint on Thursday? I could do with the company.
cases.note: Name it in one line, privately rather than in the group, assume good intent, and turn straight back to the friendship.

cases.situation: I had a miscarriage last week at 11 weeks; physically I'm recovering fine. I'd told my three closest friends, who are in my book club with me (next meeting Thursday), about the pregnancy a couple of weeks ago, so they need to know. I don't want to talk about it much yet and I don't want them to be weird around me.
cases.reply: I need to tell you something hard, and I'd rather do it in writing: I lost the pregnancy last week. Physically I'm okay, and I'm taking it a day at a time. I'm not ready to talk about it much yet, so please don't worry about finding the right words; a heart or an 'I'm here' is plenty. What would help most is you being normal with me, so yes, I'm still coming to book club on Thursday.
cases.note: Hard news to people who knew the good news: the fact in one line, then a clear signal of the support wanted, which here is normality. If bleeding or pain gets worse, or the low mood doesn't lift, see a doctor.

cases.situation: 我和女朋友小林上周领证结婚了，决定不办婚礼，两个人去云南旅行就算了。爸妈提前知道，也支持。春节回老家想给长辈敬酒。现在想在家族群里说一声，怕长辈们觉得没被尊重。
cases.reply: 各位长辈、兄弟姐妹：跟大家报个喜，我和小林上周领证结婚了！我们商量后决定不办婚礼，两个人去云南走一走当蜜月。爸妈之前已经知道，也很支持我们。春节回老家的时候，我们俩一起给大家敬酒、发喜糖。谢谢大家一直以来的关心！
cases.note: 先告诉爸妈，再发家族群；喜讯放第一句，“不办婚礼”一句说清，再给长辈一个具体的见面场合，比解释原因更显尊重。

cases.situation: I'm Sarah. My dad Dave died peacefully on Sunday after a short illness. He bowled in a Thursday-night league for 20 years and I'm in their WhatsApp group because I set it up for him. The funeral is Friday Oct 9 at 11am at St Mary's in Harrow. I need to tell them, and I'll pass on their messages to Mum.
cases.reply: This is Sarah, Dave's daughter. Dad died on Sunday, peacefully, after a short illness. He bowled with all of you on Thursday nights for twenty years. The funeral is on Friday 9 October at 11am at St Mary's, Harrow, and you'd all be very welcome. No need to message me individually; I'll pass on anything you post here to Mum.
cases.note: Telling someone else's circle: who you are first, the fact plainly, the arrangements, and how you'd like them to respond.

cases.situation: I'm gay, I've known for a while and I'm happy about it. I'm planning to come out to my parents in person at Thanksgiving. I want to tell my older sister Megan first, by text tonight since she lives in Denver, and ask her not to say anything to Mom and Dad yet.
cases.reply: Megs, I want you to be the first to know, before Mom and Dad: I'm gay. I've known for a while and honestly I'm happy. I'm planning to tell them in person at Thanksgiving, so please keep it between us until then. Call me tomorrow night if you're free? I'd love to hear your voice.
cases.note: Closest person first, the news in the first line, and a clear cue for how to respond: keep it private until the parents hear it in person.

cases.situation: My wife died three years ago. I've been seeing a woman named Carol, whom I met at the library book group, for four months and I'd like to bring her to Thanksgiving. I want to tell my two adult kids first, separately, starting with my daughter Anna tonight by text.
cases.reply: Anna, I wanted you to hear this from me before it comes up any other way: I've been seeing someone. Her name is Carol, we met at the library book group, and it's been about four months. It doesn't change anything about how much I miss your mom. I'd love for you to meet her before Thanksgiving, maybe lunch, just the three of us, but only when you're ready. Call me whenever you want to talk, or take some time first, both are fine.
cases.note: Tell each child individually before any gathering, and say plainly that either a call or some space is a fine response.

cases.situation: Je vais emménager avec mon compagnon Julien en janvier, dans le même quartier. Mon ex, Marc, est le père de nos deux enfants, Léa (8 ans) et Tom (11 ans), et on s'entend correctement. Je le dis aux enfants ce week-end et je veux que Marc l'apprenne par moi avant.
cases.reply: Bonjour Marc, je préfère que tu l'apprennes par moi avant que les enfants t'en parlent : Julien et moi allons emménager ensemble en janvier. On reste dans le même quartier, donc rien ne change pour l'école ni pour la garde. Je l'annonce à Léa et Tom ce week-end ; si tu veux qu'on se mette d'accord avant sur ce qu'on leur dit, appelle-moi quand tu veux.
cases.note: Pour un coparent, commencer par ce qui ne change pas pour les enfants : c'est sa vraie question.

cases.situation: I stopped drinking in July and I'm doing well. Our uni friends have a reunion weekend in Leeds on Saturday Oct 17, and it's always been a big drinking thing. I want to tell the group chat beforehand so nobody makes a fuss or keeps offering me pints.
cases.reply: Bit of news before the 17th: I stopped drinking back in July and I'm really glad I did. I'm still coming and still up for a late one, I'll just be on the soft stuff. No need to make a thing of it, the only favour I'd ask is not offering me pints, even as a joke. Can't wait to see you all.
cases.note: If anyone in the group is a close friend, tell them one-to-one first; in the group, say exactly how you want people to respond.

cases.situation: 我怀孕了，现在14周，预产期是明年3月中旬，目前一切正常。团队还不知道，想先发微信告诉直属领导刘姐，下周二我们有一对一。我手上负责年底会员系统上线。
cases.reply: 刘姐，想先私下跟您说一件事：我怀孕了，预产期是明年3月中旬，目前一切正常。团队那边我还没说，想先跟您商量好再告诉大家，这段时间麻烦您先帮我保密。年底会员系统上线我会按计划推进，产假前的交接我也会提前准备好方案。下周二一对一的时候，能不能多留20分钟，一起聊聊后面的安排？
cases.note: 告诉领导也是先私下、再公开：消息放第一句，说清希望她怎么做（先保密），再给出工作上的安排。

cases.situation: 我和未婚夫小赵分手了，原定明年5月16日的婚礼取消。三个月前给大概20位亲友发过婚期预告，双方父母已经知道。想发一条统一的消息告诉这些人，不想被问原因。
cases.reply: 跟大家说一声：我和小赵分开了，原定明年5月16日的婚礼取消，之前发的婚期预告就不作数了。这是我们俩认真商量后的决定，我还好，只是需要点时间。原因就不细说了，也请大家先别问。过段时间我约大家吃饭，到时候就聊点别的。
cases.note: 取消的消息只说一次：事实放第一句，说清楚希望大家怎么回应，再给一个以后见面的出口。

cases.situation: I'm transitioning, and from now on I'm going by Dani and using she/her; I'm happy and a bit nervous. I've already told my parents and my closest friend. I want to tell our 8-person climbing group chat before our session on Saturday Oct 3, and I don't want a big fuss, I just want people to use the name.
cases.reply: Some news before Saturday: I'm transitioning, and from now on I'm Dani and I use she/her. I'm happy, and a bit nervous to be typing this. You don't need to say anything big; the best thing you can do is just use the name, and if you slip up, a quick correction and carry on is completely fine. See you on the wall Saturday.
cases.note: Tell people exactly how to respond, including what to do when they get it wrong, so nobody freezes.

cases.situation: 9月27日（日）に長女が生まれました。3,120gで母子ともに元気です。両親にはもう伝えたので、会社の同期8人のLINEグループに報告したい。ただ、妻が落ち着くまでお見舞いは11月以降にしてほしい。
cases.reply: ご報告です。9月27日に長女が生まれました！3,120gで、母子ともに元気です。まだ実感がわかないくらい、ただただ嬉しいです。妻と娘が落ち着くまで、お見舞いは11月以降にしてもらえると助かります。そのときはぜひ顔を見に来てください！
cases.note: 身近な人に先に伝えてからグループへ。ニュースを最初に、気持ちを一言、どう反応してほしいか（お見舞いは11月以降）をはっきり書く。

cases.situation: My husband and I have been approved to adopt, and we're being matched with a three-year-old boy called Leo; if all goes well he'll move in with us around Christmas. I want to text my parents before our usual Sunday call. I don't want them asking about his birth family, that's his story to tell one day.
cases.reply: Mom, Dad, some big news before Sunday so it isn't a surprise on the call: we've been approved to adopt, and we're being matched with a little boy called Leo, who's three. If all goes well, he'll move in with us around Christmas. We're so excited and a bit terrified. One ask: please don't ask about his birth family, that's his story to tell one day. We'll tell you everything else on Sunday.
cases.note: Big news with one boundary: the news first, a line of feeling, what's next, and the one question to leave alone.

cases.situation: My wife and I are selling the house our three kids grew up in and moving to a flat near the coast; we've accepted an offer and completion is 11 December. The kids are 28, 31 and 34 and live in different cities. I want to tell them in our family WhatsApp before a neighbour mentions it, and invite them home for one last weekend there, 21 and 22 November.
cases.reply: Some news we wanted you to hear from us first: Mum and I are selling the house. We've accepted an offer, completion is 11 December, and we're moving to a flat near the coast. It's the right time for us, and it still feels strange to write. Before it goes, we'd love all three of you home for one last weekend there, Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November. Can you make it?
cases.note: Adult children equally close can hear it together, at the same moment; the invitation gives them somewhere to put the feeling.

cases.situation: 总监今天告诉我，我升任设计组组长，国庆后10月8日（周四）例会上正式宣布，他同意我提前私下先跟小周说。小周资历比我老，也申请了这个岗位。想先单独发微信给她，不想让她在会上才听到。
cases.reply: 小周，有件事想在例会前先单独跟你说：总监定了由我接任设计组组长，10月8日例会上宣布。我知道你也申请了，你资历比我老，这事我不想让你在会上才听到。以后组里很多事还要靠你，节后想约你喝杯咖啡聊聊，你看哪天方便？
cases.note: 好消息对某个人是坏消息时，先单独、提前告诉她，承认她的付出，不替她消化情绪；在工作场合，先得到上级同意再私下说。

cases.situation: 去年我确诊淋巴瘤，大学宿舍群的五个姐妹一直陪着我。今天复查结果出来，医生说完全缓解了，以后每三个月还要复查一次。想在群里告诉她们，也谢谢大家。
cases.reply: 姐妹们，报个好消息：今天复查结果出来了，医生说完全缓解了！以后每三个月还要复查一次，但今天先好好高兴一下。这一年你们陪着我，每一条消息我都记得。等我再养一养，请大家吃饭，地方你们挑！
cases.note: 好消息也要短：消息本身、一句感受、一句接下来做什么，再把感谢说具体。

cases.situation: I'm Kate. My husband Dan and I are separating and he moves out on Saturday 10 October. We told our son Leo, who's 8, last weekend. I want to email his teacher, Ms Rivera, so she knows if he seems off, but I don't want it raised with him at school or mentioned to other parents.
cases.reply: Dear Ms Rivera, I wanted to let you know that Leo's dad and I are separating, and Dan moves out on Saturday 10 October. We told Leo last weekend, but he may be more tired or upset than usual over the next few weeks. Please don't raise it with him unless he brings it up himself, and I'd be grateful if it stays between us. If you notice anything, I'd really like to hear, just reply to this email. Thank you, Kate
cases.note: Telling someone who looks after your child: the fact, what they might see, and exactly how you'd like them to handle it.

cases.situation: 我被医生诊断为中度抑郁，从10月12日（周一）开始请三个月病假，按医生的方案吃药和做心理咨询，人还好，就是很累。想在我和小敏、阿琳的三人群里说一声，不想被劝“想开点”，更希望她们偶尔约我出去走走。
cases.reply: 想跟你们说件事，打字说比较容易：我被诊断为中度抑郁，从10月12日开始请三个月病假，在按医生的方案吃药和做心理咨询。我还好，就是很累。不用想怎么安慰我，也不用劝我想开点，你们偶尔约我出去走走，我就很感激了。这周末谁有空，一起去公园散散步？
cases.note: 直接说清想要的是陪伴而不是建议；如果情况变糟或出现伤害自己的念头，马上联系医生或当地心理援助热线，有危险时直接打急救电话。

cases.situation: I'm 34 and have just been fitted with hearing aids after a test showed moderate hearing loss in both ears. I want to tell my team of seven in our Slack channel before Monday's stand-up, and ask them to face me when they talk and keep cameras on in calls so I can lip-read. I'm relieved, and I don't want it to be a big thing.
cases.reply: Quick bit of news before Monday's stand-up: I've just been fitted with hearing aids, after a test showed moderate hearing loss in both ears. Honestly, it's a relief to hear properly again. Two things that help me a lot: facing me when you talk, and cameras on in calls so I can lip-read. No need to make a thing of it, and if I ask you to repeat something, that's just me catching up.
cases.note: The news in the first line, one line of feeling, then turn 'how to respond' into two concrete habits people can actually do.

cases.situation: Tengo 38 años y estoy embarazada de 16 semanas, sola y por decisión propia, con un donante; salgo de cuentas a mediados de marzo. Mis padres ya lo saben y quiero contárselo a mi abuela Carmen, que tiene 84 años y es muy tradicional, por WhatsApp antes de la comida familiar del domingo. No quiero que me pregunte por el padre delante de todos.
cases.reply: Abuela, quiero que lo sepas por mí antes del domingo: estoy embarazada, de 16 semanas, y salgo de cuentas a mediados de marzo. He decidido tener este bebé sola, con ayuda de un donante, y estoy muy feliz. Te pido una cosa: que el domingo no hablemos del padre, porque esa parte es solo mía. Lo que más ilusión me hace es que vas a ser bisabuela.
cases.note: La noticia primero, una línea de sentimiento y una petición concreta sobre cómo responder; si quiere hablarlo más, mejor a solas otro día.

cases.situation: I've just accepted a senior engineer job at a robotics company, starting Monday 2 November. My best friend Marcus was laid off three weeks ago and is still looking. I want to tell him myself, by text, before I update LinkedIn on Monday.
cases.reply: Wanted you to hear this from me before it's on LinkedIn on Monday: I've accepted a senior engineer job at a robotics company, starting 2 November. I know the timing isn't easy with everything you're dealing with, so no need to say anything big, or anything at all. I'm still in your corner for the job hunt, and the first round's on me whenever you fancy it.
cases.note: Good news to someone going through the opposite: tell them individually and first, and give them permission not to celebrate.

cases.situation: 我和老公阿明结婚五年，认真商量后决定不要孩子，这个决定很坚定，我们俩现在过得很好。我妈每次打电话都问什么时候要孩子，这周日我们回家吃饭。想先给爸妈发条微信说清楚，免得饭桌上再提，亲戚那边我们想自己说。
cases.reply: 爸、妈，有件事想在周日吃饭前先跟你们说：我和阿明认真商量过，决定不要孩子，这是我们想好了的。我知道你们一直盼着，一下子可能不好接受，有想问的，周日我们可以单独聊。只是饭桌上就别再提了，亲戚那边如果问起，我们自己来说。我们俩现在过得很好，周日见。
cases.note: 先单独告诉爸妈，再说清希望他们怎么回应；不用把理由一条条摆出来，理由越多越容易被逐条反驳。

cases.situation: We had a kitchen fire in our flat on Tuesday night. Everyone's safe, including the cat, but we can't live there for at least two months, so we're staying at my sister Jo's in Cheadle. I want to tell our antenatal class group chat of 8 parents; what would genuinely help is clothes for our daughter Isla, who's 2 and wears size 2-3, and I'd rather not go over the details yet.
cases.reply: Some news so you hear it from us: we had a kitchen fire at the flat on Tuesday night. Everyone's safe, cat included, but we can't live there for at least two months, so we're staying with my sister Jo in Cheadle. We're shaken but okay. If you'd like to help, Isla needs clothes in size 2-3, and hand-me-downs would be perfect. We'd rather not go over the details yet, but a playdate soon would be lovely.
cases.note: Hard news with a practical ask: say exactly what helps, and what you'd rather not talk about, so people don't have to guess.

cases.situation: Tom and I got engaged on Saturday. I was saving it for a call this weekend with my best friend Priya in Singapore because of the time difference, but last night my cousin Ellie posted a congratulations photo on Facebook first, and Priya has probably seen it. I want to message her now.
cases.reply: Priya, you should have heard this from me, not from Ellie's post, and I'm sorry it went that way: Tom and I got engaged on Saturday! I was saving it for a proper call this weekend because of the time difference, and Facebook got there first. I'm so happy and I want to tell you all of it. Can I call you tomorrow, at whatever time suits you?
cases.note: When the order breaks, own it in one line and still give the closest person her own moment: a call, not a reply in the comments.

cases.situation: 我第二次考研还是没过，差了8分。这一年爸妈每个月给我2000元生活费，支持我在家备考。成绩出来后我想了很久，决定不再考了，下个月开始找运营方面的工作。想先给爸妈发微信，不想他们劝我再考一年。
cases.reply: 爸、妈，想先跟你们说件事：第二次考研还是没过，差了8分。我挺难受的，但已经想清楚了，不再考了，下个月开始找运营方面的工作。这一年你们每个月给我2000块生活费撑着我，我都记着。不用劝我再考一年，我更希望你们支持我这个决定。周末我打电话跟你们细说。
cases.note: 坏消息和决定一起说：结果放第一句，一句感受，一句接下来做什么，再明说希望他们怎么回应。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance translator. Since my divorce I'm going back to my maiden name, so from Monday 12 October I'll be Laura Bennett instead of Laura Hughes, with a new email, laura.bennett@example.com. I want to email my 15 regular clients without mentioning the divorce or inviting sympathy, just making the switch easy.
cases.reply:
Subject: My name and email change on Monday 12 October
Hi all, a quick update: from Monday 12 October I'll be working as Laura Bennett instead of Laura Hughes, with a new email address, laura.bennett@example.com. Nothing else changes: same service, same me. Please update your records to the new name and address. No need to reply, and I look forward to the next project.
Laura
cases.note: Personal news in a work channel: only what people need to act on, no backstory, and a clear 'no need to reply'.

cases.situation: 我拿到了慕尼黑一家公司的工作，明年3月过去，合同两年，我很兴奋，也有点舍不得。爸妈都七十多了，身体还行，我哥住在同城，答应每周回去看他们。我想先给爸妈发条微信，周末再回家当面细说，最担心他们觉得没人照顾。
cases.reply: 爸、妈，有件事想先跟你们说，周末回家再细聊：我拿到了慕尼黑一家公司的工作，明年3月过去，合同两年。我知道你们最先想到的是家里，我哥已经答应每周回去看你们。我很兴奋，也有点舍不得，但这个机会我想抓住。周末回家，你们想问什么都可以问我。
cases.note: 会让人担心的消息：第一句说事实，第二句先回答他们最大的担心，再说一句感受和下一步。

cases.situation: 我今年32岁，上个月被医生确诊为成人ADHD（注意力缺陷多动障碍），已经按医嘱开始治疗，这几周状态好了很多，心里也松了口气。想先发微信告诉爸妈，怕他们觉得是小时候没管好我而自责，也不想他们到处查资料或者跟亲戚说。这周六我回家吃饭。
cases.reply: 爸、妈，有件事想先跟你们说，周六回家再细聊：上个月医生确诊我是成人ADHD，就是注意力缺陷多动障碍。我已经按医嘱开始治疗，这几周状态好了很多，说实话心里松了口气。这不是谁的错，更不是你们小时候没管好我，不用自责。资料先别去查，也先别跟亲戚说，有什么想问的，周六直接问我就好。
cases.note: 可能让读的人内疚的消息：事实放第一句，一句感受，再直接说清不是谁的错、希望他们怎么回应。

cases.situation: My husband Mark died two years ago, and I'm still close to his parents, Joan and Bill, who see our kids most weekends. I'm marrying Paul in the spring, and I want to tell Joan and Bill by letter before the kids mention it, let them know Mark will always be part of our family and so will they, and invite them to the wedding.
cases.reply: Dear Joan and Bill, I wanted you to hear this from me before the children mention it: Paul and I are getting married in the spring. Mark will always be part of this family, and so will you. It would mean a great deal to me and to the kids if you came to the wedding. Take whatever time you need with this, and I'd love to come round and talk whenever you're ready.
cases.note: News that may reopen grief: tell them first and individually, say what doesn't change, and give them room to respond in their own time.
